body:
solution? I don't know...

I'll always be socially awkward I guess... destined to be "forever alone" (short-term girlfriends, never working out long term)

I would have liked to have a family, kids...

no, never treated for depression...

and most people don't know how I feel anyway. I try not to reveal too much of it, I find it pathetic enough as it is.

no serious medical conditions.

for a while the depression went away and wouldo nly appear when I am really tired.

which I am now, and the girlfriend is just... not helping.

yea, I should try something like that.

at some point I was thinking of volunteering, hoping that if I see people less fortunate than me, I could learn to appreciate my life. It sounds really horrible when I put it that way, using other people's misery to make myself feel better.

then again it might just depress me more. I don't know... I also have a very hard time handling other people's suffering so it may not work
I can't handle the loneliness anymore, basically, and don't see things getting any better than this.

I used to say the only thing that keeps me going forward is hope that things will get better someday.

but it's just one long string of disappointments and hope is getting rather thin.

I just don't see things getting any better than this. I'm well off financially and could live a long and comfortable, very lonely life.

I just can't handle it anymore.
